scope.summary: Narrow PR-vs-PR blocking to shared changed paths and SQL ownership, retain fail-closed safety checks, and document advisory/recovery behavior.
implemented: Broad component overlaps are advisory for PR checks, while the independent issue-dispatch lease policy remains unchanged.
Evidence paths are scoped to PR number; concrete file and SQL overlaps remain hard conflicts.
Malformed peer metadata is classified; database ownership and invalid API/file data remain fail-closed.
Actionable coordination messages and recovery documentation were added.

criteria.description: Two PRs changing distinct UI files within the same application area can both pass coordination.

evidence.outcome: Same application:settings category with distinct paths returns advisory only and no hard conflict.

criteria.description: Two PRs changing distinct tests in the same suite can both pass coordination.

evidence.outcome: Two distinct auth.spec.mjs paths map to test:auth and do not hard-conflict.

criteria.description: Two PRs with distinct evidence paths for the same parent issue can both pass coordination.

evidence.outcome: issue-91/pr-271 and issue-91/pr-269 evidence paths map to separate ownership values.

criteria.description: Empty draft PR remains non-blocking; malformed own PR fails; empty non-draft PR remains invalid.

evidence.outcome: Tests cover empty drafts, malformed candidate metadata, empty non-draft candidates, and classified malformed peers.

criteria.description: Same changed file and same SQL object still trigger concrete hard conflicts; unreadable migrations fail safely.

evidence.outcome: Exact shared-file and shared SQL-object cases remain hard conflicts; unreadable migration-blob API failure was not induced locally.
Migration content retrieval still rejects unreadable or invalid GitHub blob responses before overlap evaluation.

criteria.description: Fresh PR metadata and SHA are used; stale historical PR base SHA cannot reintroduce the old policy.

evidence.outcome: Static regressions assert fresh PR fetch, current trusted Development policy, and merge-group queued head SHA comparison.

criteria.description: Tests reproduce past false-conflict patterns from farbotkol/butterbox#251, farbotkol/butterbox#264 and farbotkol/butterbox#267 plus positive true-conflict cases.

evidence.outcome: Covers Playwright spec naming, empty drafts, oversized Xero SQL ownership, broad category overlap, exact files, and shared SQL objects.
Covers the trusted checkout and current/queued SHA safeguards associated with #267.

criteria.description: Demonstrate two independent Copilot PRs passing coordination concurrently, then pass real required checks; report results with links.

evidence.outcome: PR #272 coordination passed against the still-trusted base policy.
PR #269 coordination passed while #272 was open; not a validation of the unmerged policy change.
PR #272 verify failed at the missing PR reference/marker contract; database job had not completed at the recorded time.

tests.result: ESLint passed for all changed JavaScript files.

decisions: Keep the generic component-overlap behavior used by local issue-dispatch leases unchanged; narrow only PR-vs-PR hard conflicts.
Do not modify GitHub workflow gates or the trusted pull_request_target/merge_group checkout policy.
Leave this PR as draft and do not merge or deploy.
limitations: The current PR body lacks the canonical Refs #271 and issue/evidence marker lines and has a generated Fixes #271 suffix.
The canonical issue uses a Tests / acceptance criteria heading with plain bullets; the evidence gate parser expects a separate checkbox heading format.
No merge-group run or real green verify/database pair on the changed PR was observed.
CodeQL reported no analyzable changed code and performed no analysis.
blockers: PR body cannot be edited with the available task tools; an owner/reviewer must correct it before verify can pass.
Required verify and database checks have not both passed.
The full concurrency acceptance remains unverified on the changed trusted policy.
